column1: # S2 NAIVE classic-saw baseline -- the Delta denominator for the acceptance gate.
#   PROVENANCE: rendered by the probe's self-built DroneBank (ruling B, @Kimi f260fd91),
#   driftEnabled=false, BEFORE any polyBLEP correction was applied to the product.
#   The in-production runtime path was NOT modified to produce these numbers.
#   FIDELITY: gh19_fidelity.tsv in the same probe cache asserts, per cell, that the
#   self-built drift-ON arm is BIT-IDENTICAL to the runtime render and that flipping the
#   drift flag alone changes it. So this arm differs from the shipped path by exactly one
#   known quantity (the drift flag) and by nothing else.
#   cells    : 36 (drone1_classic 12 LOW / drone4_classic 12 LOW / drone4_classic_v0 12 HIGH)
#   LANES ARE NOT INTERCHANGEABLE: drone4_classic and drone4_classic_v0 are the same
#   generator group at different VOLT settings, so they occupy DIFFERENT bands (97-224 Hz
#   vs ~551-1266 Hz). The volt lane is part of the cell id for exactly this reason.
#   Delta_cell = blpin_full_db(current corrected run) - blpin_full_db(this table);
#   the gate requires Delta_cell >= its per-cell threshold. On this table Delta is 0.
